closure: Auxiliary phase diffuses with diag(Kx,Ky); its complete velocity-correlation integral plus independent bare displacement noise yields Kx=D+a/Ky, Ky=D+b/Kx. Use the unique positive solution.
limitations: No new independent continuum reference was run because the physical model did not change. Existing reference evidence covers 12 cases and refinements, not every followup sweep point. No data, fitting or grader exists; no measured agent difficulty.
